terms.definition: Enterprise Asset Management — the product name for the V-Smart Ledger tax compliance platform.
Vietnamese Đồng. All monetary values are stored and transmitted as integers (no decimals). Display format: vi-VN locale.
Vietnamese business tax identification number. Format: 10 digits or 10-3 digits (e.g., 0123456789 or 0123456789-001).
Official Vietnamese tax invoice (hóa đơn điện tử — electronic invoice) issued per transaction. Must comply with Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC.
A physical or virtual retail location. All data is scoped to a store. Users belong to one store.
Stock Keeping Unit — unique product identifier within a store.
Role-Based Access Control. Roles: admin, store-manager, cashier, accountant, viewer.
The JSON-based project knowledge base at wiki/. Contains features, bugs, decisions, contracts, and more.

The three-tier AI agent skill system. Layer 0 = orchestration (vibe-project-manager). Layer 1 = role-general (vibe-ba, vibe-backend-general, etc.). Layer 2 = tech-specific (vibe-backend-nestjs, etc.).
2-week development cycle. Tracked in wiki/dashboard.json and wiki/plan/backlog.json.
API contracts must be created and approved by vibe-api-contractor BEFORE any backend implementation begins.
Records are never hard-deleted. The deletedAt column is set instead. All queries exclude soft-deleted records by default.
